spans.s:
कैरलेय कैरलेय, अस्, m. a king of the
Keralas.

कैरव कैरव, अस्, m. a gambler, a cheat,
a rogue; an enemy; (अम्), n. the white esculent
water-lily or lotus blossoming at night; (ई), f. moon-
shine, moonlight; N. of a plant, = मेथिका.
—कै-
रव-बन्धु, उस्, m. an epithet of the moon.

कैरविन्, ई, m. the moon; (इणी), f. a place or
pond abounding in water-lilies, an assemblage of
them.
—कैरविणी-खण्ड, अम्, n. a multitude of
spots filled with water-lilies.

कैराटक कैराटक, अस्, m. a species of
vegetable poison, one of the fixed kinds.

कैरात कैरात, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. किरात), relating
or belonging to the Kirātas; (अस्), m. a prince of
the Kirātas; a strong man; N. of a serpent; (अम्),
n. the plant Agathotes Chirayta; a kind of sandal-
wood.

कैरातक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the Kirāta
people.

कैरातिक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to the
Kirātas.

कैराल कैराल, अम्, ई, n. f., N. of a plant,
used as a remedy for worms; [cf. विडङ्ग.]

कैरिशि कैरिशि, इस्, m. (fr. किरिशि), a patro-
nymic of Sutvan.

कैर्मेदुर कैर्मेदुर, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), N. of
a place; (अस्, ई, अम्), coming from that place.
